pages.title: My day
pages.purpose: Your meetings, deadlines, mail waiting on you and recent files, with focus blocks you can book.

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: What needs you right now, then every queue and how old its work is.

pages.title: People & holidays
pages.purpose: Where each person is based, their days off, and public holidays by country.

pages.title: Admin
pages.purpose: Roster, settings, dropdown choices, email log and scheduled jobs.

pages.title: Team scores
pages.purpose: The team score for this month or any dates you pick, its trend, and the team leads, agents and channels behind it.

pages.title: Audit Desk
pages.purpose: Four audits per agent per day: open one, score it live in the form, and the agent gets the result by email.

pages.title: My audits
pages.purpose: Your quality audits and what lost marks; confirm your coaching (CTL) with your team lead happened.

pages.title: CTLs
pages.purpose: Go through each audit under 100% with the agent within 2 working days (3 over a day off) and submit the outcome: acknowledged or dispute. A TL on shift may close any open CTL.

pages.title: Disputes
pages.purpose: Disputes team leads raised at the CTL: record the weekly meeting outcome, or escalate to Mohamed.

pages.title: Calibration
pages.purpose: Each auditor scored against the team lead reference on the same tickets, and the auditor trend over time.

pages.title: KB gaps
pages.purpose: Knowledge-base gaps auditors flag on the day of the audit. Auditors add entries; the KB update list marks them added.

pages.title: My auditor work
pages.purpose: Your own auditor KPIs for a month, the audits you did and any dispute raised on them.

pages.title: Quality analytics
pages.purpose: Scores by agent, team lead, channel and question; auditor and CTL KPIs.

pages.title: Audit forms
pages.purpose: The audit questions per channel, their weights, and the critical questions that zero an audit.

pages.title: Status validation
pages.purpose: IDLE time with cases in it, flagged for your review: accept the status it counts as, or revert with a reason.

pages.title: My status
pages.purpose: Your flagged IDLE time, raw, suggested and reviewed, and your productivity before and after; dispute a flag.

pages.title: Productivity analytics
pages.purpose: Idle before and after validation, its effect on productivity, and how flags are reviewed.

pages.title: TPH and caps
pages.purpose: Which channel each agent is on, the cases waiting each hour, and each agent’s touches against their share of them.

pages.title: Queue health
pages.purpose: Every queue now: open work, its age, and how it moved since the last check-in.

pages.title: Aging cases
pages.purpose: Unresolved tickets by age, getting redder the longer they stay open.

pages.title: Check-ins
pages.purpose: Queue status at 09:30, 13:00, 18:30 and 22:00 Kuwait time.

pages.title: Analytics
pages.purpose: Inflow by day, week and month: inbound calls, chats and internal escalations.

pages.title: Heatmap
pages.purpose: Headcount needed per interval and per shift, by country, with every assumption editable.

pages.title: TL scheduler
pages.purpose: Who works which shift, and what each team lead is doing in every hour of the day.

pages.title: Agent performance
pages.purpose: Each agent’s productivity and trend, from the V1 productivity engine.

pages.title: 1:1s
pages.purpose: Schedule and log topic-driven 1:1s. A 1:1 not logged the same day triggers a reminder.

pages.title: TL tasks
pages.purpose: Tasks for team leads with a timeline from start to deadline, progress updates and reminders.

pages.title: Meetings & BRs
pages.purpose: Notes and action items from meetings and business reviews, reviewed at the next one.

pages.title: My actions
pages.purpose: What you agreed to in 1:1s and meetings, and where each stands.

pages.title: Notes
pages.purpose: Your private scratchpad: get a thought down now, tag and sort it later, turn it into a task when it is ready.

pages.title: Coaching signals
pages.purpose: Suggest a 1:1 topic for one person, e.g. a QA finding; it reaches their team lead.

pages.title: Hard cases
pages.purpose: A log of difficult cases to coach from, each one linkable to a 1:1.

pages.title: Month-end KPI close
pages.purpose: Final agent, team lead and auditor scores from settled data, deductions applied, exceptions with a reason, then the month locked.

pages.title: Trackers
pages.purpose: Blocked customers, promocodes, operational loss, customer strikes and more, in one place.

pages.title: Escalation matrix
pages.purpose: Who to escalate to, for which issue, and after how long, built and kept in one place.

pages.title: TL performance
pages.purpose: A team lead's week: team scores, responsibilities, projects against expectation, queue hours and mails to answer.

pages.title: KB tracker
pages.purpose: Knowledge-base updates: when each was asked for, when it was done, and whether it was accurate.

pages.title: KPI logs
pages.purpose: What no system records: HR-confirmed behaviour cases, unplanned leaves, and tickets left out of an area's SLA. The scorecard reads them.

pages.title: Mail desk
pages.purpose: Approval mails to answer in their thread, and MyFatoorah refund updates and chargebacks: who was on queue, who replied and when.

pages.title: FCR
pages.purpose: First contact resolution: scoring, raw data, analytics and insights.
